note: nRF52/STM32L4-class sensor node on a CR2032. 1 s frame repeats: RTC tick ISR every 250 ms (sensor FIFO check) + one measure/BLE-TX burst. Times are integer us; tick period 250 ms = 8192 RTC ticks of 32.768 kHz, so all ticks share the same phase vs. the meter sample clock in a short capture.

dut.note: v_src = bench/meter source standing in for a fresh CR2032; c_dut = total decoupling on VDD_MCU; v_bor = MCU brown-out threshold (representative - check the MCU datasheet)

target.note: avg error is judged on ONE 1-s capture at the worst sample phase; range_burden_v = shunt drop at full scale of the lowest auto-range (overrange detect point)
